scope: Exploratory extension specified after historical and supplementary outcomes had been seen. No new supplementary analysis, inference, or calibration claims.

settings.optimizer: L-BFGS-B finite-difference derivatives; successful starts plus exact nested candidates; no global maximum guarantee
settings.training_responses: Second through final training year, identical to original fits
settings.numerics: Normalized retained-path distributions; M/U exact-arithmetic bounds with cap doubling. Floating point mass discrepancy is reported, not a certified rounding bound.
settings.aggregation: Six equal prior weights; one-step likelihood update with learning rate one, no sharing or tuning; each 1978-2013 outcome updates once.
